package.json's test scripts and tools/ci/tooling-fast.mjs's file list are
GENERATED from this file by tools/gen/gen-test-groups.mjs; edit here, then
run that generator. `--check` is on the fast gate, so drift fails at once.
Adding a group used to mean three coordinated edits (package.json, the
tooling-fast list, docs/TESTING.md); it is one edit here now.

In `toolingFast`, an entry beginning `//` is a comment line emitted verbatim into the generated block — the notes explaining why a given file earns a place in the edit loop live here, not in the generated file.
